| Category = Breakfast recipes

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
*2 small breakfast [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausages]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
*[[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|Cream cheese]]
*1 ciabatta roll, sliced open
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]

==Procedure==
# Cut the sausages into small pieces and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] until done. Drain grease if needed and, if you desire, rinse very lightly, using a [[Cookbook:Colander|colander]], then return to the pan.
# Add the egg and mix into the sausage pieces until all the liquid is gone. Add salt and pepper for taste.
# Thickly spread the cream cheese onto the ciabatta roll, and pile the egg and sausage mix into the roll.
# Serve classic sandwich style or keep the halves separate.
